release_notes: Groundwork for Smart watering: the controller can now water on a schedule, skip runs when the soil is moist or rain is forecast, and split long runs into shorter, spaced-out chunks. The set-up screens come in a later update. Watering, including Run Now, now needs a GardenInsight subscription. The old AI advisor has been removed and its stored Claude API key deleted from the controller. Rain history is recorded again.
